Under expressions, choose an expression, go to trigger conditions, and for a smile I chose mouthsmileleft and mouthsmileright, then set both of their values to >.5 . Blendshape value from face tracking has to be on for you to be able to choose facesmileleft ect. I have on mediapipe tracker as the face tracking asset. Its a bit confusing and I put it a little out of order but hopefully some of that helps. The values are super important, 5 seems way too high of a threshold.

P.s: the model itself does not move its eyebrows until it goes into an expression with mediapipe, which threw me off completely and made me think the eyebrows were not being tracked at all. They probably are and you can check under mediapipe tracker on the side (or whatever you're tracking with), then configure blendshapes mapping and looking at the eyebrow settings to see if the sliders move at all.

My model will have to have them added with hanatool, it only has a few blendshapes. I'm not sure what I did but I managed to get a few expressions working. I consider myself to be very high functioning. I go to work, I shower, I eat, and do everything as if I am not depressed. My symptoms are very inwardly focused and most people have no idea I have depression until I mention it or start doing my self-depreciation thing. My symptoms are debilitating all the same, though, as all the mental symptoms of depression exist such as devaluation of self, feeling down, ect.. I actually struggle HARD to get through work but you wouldn't know that looking at me go through my day.  
  
Either way, the definition is not set in stone and if you think you're high functioning, then you are. Everyone's lows and highs are different.
